title: dirvec-study: code, data manifests, pre-registration briefs and results for 'A few vectors for a mixed folder'
description:
Code, data manifests, pre-registration briefs (with OpenTimestamps proofs) and per-session results for the preprint A few vectors for a mixed folder: a pre-registered measurement of pooled directory embeddings (Ali Basheer, 2026), doi:10.5281/zenodo.23178122. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

Please cite the paper: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23178122.
